1. A missing view or table reads as empty/OK: v_activity_score 08-22 → execution_traces 08-19 → 22 dead migrations 09-22 → still read on 09-28.
2. Fixes that are not running: f2857fc → tier fixes not loaded 08-20 → fixes on the 5% path 08-22 → stranded commits 09-22.

4. alphaBetaDelta reporting that misstates what was learned.
5. Goals captured onto a victim file, ×3 on 09-18.
6. Lessons written to channels the consumer never reads.
7. Probe artifacts that are never retired.

problems.symptom: Fields are written with no reader, or read with no writer. Missing views and tables read as empty with status OK, so fallbacks never fire and learning signals vanish silently.
problems.root_cause: No producer/consumer parity check exists. SurrealDB returns empty/OK for a missing table and NULL for a phantom column. Every audit proposed a written-with-no-reader detector and none was built.

problems.symptom: Green flags (validated, reached, completed, success_rate, typecheck) sit over broken artifacts
problems.root_cause: Gates check that the output is present, parses or typechecks, not that it works. Producer and verifier share the same rule.

problems.symptom: Fixes land in git but the running process is older code, and every health signal stays green
problems.root_cause: Pull-sync writes its marker before the restart; converge_units never enables timers; stranded commits wedge the pull; IF NOT EXISTS schema divergence

problems.symptom: Blame is annihilated or misdirected: the counterfeit Beta, satellites stamped reached:false, UCB on exit status, recommend dropping α/β, env-armed interlocks
problems.root_cause: Multiple posterior stores and several transit paths, each with its own key and semantics. The instrument (alphaBetaDelta) misreports.

problems.symptom: Pathless natural-language goals are captured onto victim files by regex edit-intent, and the dispatch record gets rewritten
problems.root_cause: A lexical createIntent/early edit-intent regex; target inference returns empty or fs_edit; head-of-line producer scan at missingNow[0]

problems.symptom: Fixes are correct but inert: no caller, a minority path, interface-only partials, a probe template never retired
problems.root_cause: Landing is verified at the edited layer rather than where the change is consumed, and the traffic denominator is not measured

problems.symptom: Lessons are placed in channels the consumer never reads (concept-db vs the author planner; verbatim lessons fail closed)
problems.root_cause: Lessons are written before the runtime reader is named

problems.symptom: Extraction yield ~0.1%; the middle tier never fires; mints don't compound; activities are 76% duplicate families with 1.2% provenance
problems.root_cause: Ribosome eligibility is a literal list naming 1-of-5-task templates; extraction outputs a trace description; proposal minting outpaces earned minting

problems.symptom: The trace store is flushed by an auth storm, cold boot poisons inserts, 22 migrations are dead, full-view scans pin the DB
problems.root_cause: Retention indexes on boolean fields; reader-less computed views; applySQLFile skips failures silently; unbounded default window

problems.symptom: A substrate commit deletes gate logic (54b7762) or misplaces a regex (1268a11), and nothing detects it
problems.root_cause: The typecheck gate passes deletions, and there is no corpus self-check of gates

problems.symptom: The planner makes a secrets-exfiltration plan, shell prefix-assignment bugs, and wrong request schemas
problems.root_cause: LLM-generated registry descriptions are semantically wrong and volatile; the planner reads only the goal text and those descriptions

problems.symptom: Selection-critical hyperparameters and interlocks are frozen from process.env
problems.root_cause: SIGNATURE_CLUSTER_N_MIN and SATISFIER_PROVEN_BAD_ARMED are still env [LIVE 09-28], along with many *_INTERVAL_MS and learning-plane flags

problems.symptom: Audits run on a spoke with activity-api masked; the spectral gate is dead on the spoke; concept-db crashlooped on the spoke; split-brain anchor
problems.root_cause: Role/profile masking combined with per-node measurement; ambiguous join anchors

problems.symptom: Fossil tables, shadowed routes, unreachable selector framework, 125 composed-cap templates with one-off shapes, unretired probe templates
problems.root_cause: No retirement path; per-goal shape naming

problems.symptom: Docs and schema say α=successes+1 while practice is a graded, decayed accumulator; docs say the transport auto-starts; a report claims a nonexistent fix
problems.root_cause: Docs and comments assert rather than get verified

principles: Name the runtime reader before writing a lesson. Recallable (R4a) is not the same as injected at the consumer (R4b). (jev FIRSTTRY-RESULTS 09-18)
One true fact at the point of use moved a planner off a secrets-exfiltration design. Information beats guardrails (law 8). (FIRSTTRY-RESULTS attempt 3)
Pre-register predictions with falsifiers, change one variable per attempt, never judge by the reach flag, and read the bytes. (jev PREREGs)
Report the unaided and information-complete verdicts separately. A pass with no compounding between attempts is two independent first tries, not learning. (PREREG-6, FIRSTTRY-RESULTS)
A produced shape with no consumer is IMPLEMENTED_DORMANT. (FIRSTTRY-RESULTS)
For every field a resolver writes, assert that at least one non-test, non-self read exists. Without that detector the half-wired class regenerates. (LEARNING_ARCHITECTURE_REVIEW §7)
Fix grading and attribution instruments before throttling minting, and fix the instruments before the fixes they verify. (LEARNING_MECHANISM_AUDIT, RUN2)
Measure the denominator first: what the traffic actually executes and what that path reads. Architecture-diagram-driven fixes optimised a 5% path. (NEEDLE_MOVERS §5)
The system cannot tell absent, empty and zero apart. Put a counted requested-vs-matched log at every cross-component read. (NEEDLE_MOVERS §4)
Read one full row before aggregating over a named field. Phantom columns return NULL, a missing table returns OK/empty, and GROUP BY LIMIT drops groups. (DB audit method notes)
A retention window is not a history. State the denominator with every reach number. (DB audit)
If the adversarial pass refutes the causal leg while the observational leg reproduces, the audit was reaching for impact. (DB audit, 6 of 7 refuted)
Verify at the consuming layer. A synthetic POST tests only the edited layer. (DB audit Addendum 3)
Additive changes to a NEW surface are safe to land. Blind changes that mutate posteriors or ribosome input are negative value. (DB audit Addenda 5/7)
If a gate refuses your edit, run it on the unmodified file. If that also refuses, the gate is the finding. (lifecycle 01, 09-22)
IF NOT EXISTS schema makes warm and cold stores silently diverge. Test cold boot. (lifecycle 01)
A rejection whose subject you cannot read is absence of evidence. (LOOP_CLOSURE 08-18)
Several defects in series, each sufficient alone, explain why fixing any one changes nothing. (LOOP_CLOSURE)
A guard that crosses a threshold can become a no-op while its comment still asserts the bound. (LOOP_CLOSURE)
Comments that assert measurements are not measurements, and a comment describing a defect may have been written by whoever fixed it. (RUN2, DB audit)
Use git grep. The ugrep shim silently misses matches after NUL bytes. (ROUND2)

Launch contract: one anchor with a loud refusal on ambiguity; cause-naming boot dependency checks; the inventory as sole authority over units; never harvest the operator's key. (launch-contract 09-15)
Kill switches stay env, outside the substrate's authoring reach. Behavioural hyperparameters go through shaped tuning params. (RUN2)
A failing self-repair is training signal. Don't hand-complete it; file the one-line cause. (GOODBEHAVIOUR 09-18)
